subject: E-Commerce
title: Transparent Pricing Wins
description: A fast breakdown of Transparent Pricing Wins for builders.

hook.text: Buffer publishes every employee's salary online. Radical transparency built a brand people trust deeply.

buildup.text: Hidden fees destroy trust faster than any discount builds it. One surprise charge loses a customer for life.

discovery.text: Costco's strategy: low margins, transparent pricing, no hidden fees. Its membership renewal rate is 93%.

twist.text: Transparent pricing feels risky but creates loyalty. Customers who trust you rarely bother price-shopping.

climax.text: In a world of dark patterns, transparency is a radical competitive advantage. Honesty builds fortresses.

punchline.text: 93% renewal rate from honest pricing. Transparency is a competitive edge.

quiz.question: What is Costco's membership renewal rate?
